name: India
dek: New Delhi (Safdarjung), WMO 42182. Hot before the monsoon; wet in July and August.
paragraphs: The reference station is New Delhi (Safdarjung), WMO 42182, height 211.4 m. Palam, Ridge, and Ayanagar are other New Delhi files and were not averaged in; Mumbai, Goa, and the south are not this table. Several months in the file count 26 to 28 years rather than 30.

The highest average high in the table is 39.9 °C, in May. The lowest average low is 7.5 °C, in January. The wettest month by the precipitation column is August, at 226.8 mm, and the driest is November, at 4.1 mm. No official tipping source was found on this pass, so that line is missing.

climate.caption: Reference station: New Delhi (Safdarjung), WMO 42182. Not a national average.
climate.note: World Meteorological Organization 1991–2020 climatological standard normals, distributed by NOAA NCEI. Monthly values are copied as printed, with leading spaces removed; a value printed with no leading zero, such as -.3, is shown as -0.3. Several months count 26 to 28 years rather than 30. Some values are printed without a decimal place and are shown that way.

plugs.label: Plugs and voltage
plugs.value: Type C, D and M, 230 V, 50 Hz
plugs.detail: The IEC world-plugs list, in the copy archived on 16 August 2026, shows India at the voltage, frequency, and plug types in the figure. A direct download of the live page did not return the list, so the archive is the copy that was read.

driving.label: Driving side
driving.detail: The Rules of the Road Regulations, 1989, regulation 2, "Keep Left", require the driver to drive as close to the left side of the road as may be expedient. The copy read is the one published by the Telangana Transport Department.
driving.sourceTitle: Rules of the Road Regulations, 1989 (Telangana Transport Department copy)

water.label: Tap water
water.detail: CDC's traveler page for India, last reviewed August 25, 2026, does not say whether tap water is safe or unsafe. It says food and water standards around the world vary based on the destination, that standards may also differ within a country, and that risk may change depending on the activity. It points readers to CDC's food and water precautions. This page does not turn that into medical advice.

currency.label: Currency
currency.detail: ISO 4217 lists the currency name Indian Rupee and the code INR for India.

timeZone.label: Time zone
timeZone.detail: IANA's zone.tab and zone1970.tab each give India one row, Asia/Kolkata. There is no second zone for the country in either file.
